title: Shows 8000% instead of 80%
plain: A new function shows the average as a percentage, so it multiplies by 100. But average_marks() ALREADY returns a percentage - that is written in marks.py, a DIFFERENT file. So 80% becomes 8000%.
diff:
--- a/report.py
+++ b/report.py
@@ -12,6 +12,12 @@
     return student["name"]
 
 
+def percent_line(student_id):
+    """Show the student's average as a percentage."""
+    average = average_marks(student_id)
+    return str(average * 100) + "%"
+
